instruction: The file employees.csv has columns emp_id,name,department,city,hired_year,salary (20 rows). What is the total salary budget (the sum of salaries) of the department with the largest number of employees? Use bash with python3 to compute it. Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
